question: Is the current-head terminal proof enough to accept the CI guard behavior change, or should a maintainer request a reviewer-owned Testbox rerun before merge?
rationale: The patch looks correct, but it changes automation diagnostics that can affect release confidence, so accepting the remaining false-pass/false-fail risk is a maintainer merge judgment.

options.title: Proceed with current proof
options.body: Accept the PR body's current-head full guard transcript plus synthetic failure-path proof and merge through the normal maintainer flow.

options.title: Request reviewer-owned rerun
options.body: Ask for or run the gateway-watch guard in a reviewer-controlled Testbox before merging the automation guard change.

recommendation.title: Proceed with current proof
recommendation.body: Accept the PR body's current-head full guard transcript plus synthetic failure-path proof and merge through the normal maintainer flow.
